rules: Sites: Anttila, Sarkisuo, Qvidja and Viikki (order of db/sites.parquet). Haltiala has no silage
harvest (grain) and gets no panel; Maktau is not in the dive. The rules are those of Deep Dive
#4 (scripts/deep-dives/disturbance-detail.ts), ported to Python. Day numbers count the days
since 1970-01-01; all windows include both end days.
1. Daily GPP, Reco (named TER here) and gap-filled NEE (g C m-2 d-1) and the measured fraction
of NEE come from data/calculated/daily.parquet (local days). Events come from
db/events.parquet.
2. Episodes: the harvest and cut events of each of the five Finnish sites are sorted by date;
an event that starts not more than 7 days after the last day of the current episode joins
it. The recorded date is the first event date of the episode. Then the OVERRIDES of Deep
Dive #4 apply (they change the first or the last day; an override that matches no episode
stops the script). Group of an event: type cut = cleaning cut; a harvest whose crop or
detail text matches /thresh|grain|faba|\boats\b|barley/i and not /\bcut\b|silage|grass/i
= grain harvest; all other harvests = silage harvest. Group of an episode: grain when one
event is a grain harvest, else silage when one event is a harvest, else cleaning cut. The
dive keeps the silage harvest episodes (25).
3. Windows from the first day (start) and the last day (end) of the episode: before = start-14
to start-1, after = end+1 to end+14, late = end+15 to end+28. The window mean is the mean
of the days with a value. The change (delta) = mean after - mean before; null when a side
has fewer than 12 days with a value. Relative change of GPP, TER and NEE = 100 x delta /
mean GPP before (null when the mean GPP before is below 0.5 g C m-2 d-1); thus
NEE % = TER % - GPP %.
4. An episode is not used (in this order) when (1) another harvest or cut episode, or a
grazing or tillage event, overlaps the days start-14 to end+14 ("overlap"); (2) GPP, TER
or NEE has fewer than 12 days in the before or the after window ("too-few-days"); (3) the
mean measured fraction of NEE is below 0.10 in a window ("low-measured-fraction"). A
fertilisation in the windows only sets a flag. 20 episodes are used.
5. Recovery: the next disturbance = the smallest start of a later harvest or cut episode or of
a grazing event of the site, minus end (tillage does not count). Recovery share = 100 x
mean GPP of end+15 to end+28 / mean GPP before; null when the next disturbance starts 28
days or less after end, the window has fewer than 12 days, or the GPP before is below 0.5.
Days to recover = the first day d (1 to 60 after end) whose centred 5-day running mean of
GPP (3 or more values) is 80 % or more of the GPP before. Censored when the next
disturbance comes first (d+2 >= next, "blocked"), when the data end ("data-end"), or after
day 60 ("max-days").
6. Change point of the GPP drop: for each candidate day t from start-10 to end+5,
drop(t) = mean GPP of t-5 to t-1 - mean GPP of t to t+4, each side with 4 or more values.
The detected day is the t with the largest drop (the first on a tie). The drop is clear
when the mean before is 1 g C m-2 d-1 or more and the drop is 25 % or more of it. Offset =
detected day - recorded date (negative = the drop came before the recorded date). An
episode is not in the timing result when another harvest or cut episode, or a grazing or
tillage event, overlaps start-15 to end+9, or when no candidate day has enough GPP days.
Pre-drop = 100 x (mean GPP of days -3 to -1 - mean of days -10 to -4) / mean of days -10 to
-4 from the recorded date (far window 5 or more values and 1 g C m-2 d-1 or more, near
window 2 or more values).
7. Composite curves per site and over all used episodes: offsets -14 to +28 from end (the
last day of the harvest); the value of an episode is null from the day end + next
disturbance on; GPP, TER and NEE as a fraction of the mean GPP before of the episode (null
when below 0.5). Per day: mean, sample SD and n over the episodes; mean and SD are null
when n < 2. The y range of Figures 1 and 2 is one range over all mean +- SD of all panels,
rounded outwards to a multiple of 0.25 and extended to hold 0 and 1. A second composite
over all used episodes holds the fluxes in g C m-2 d-1 (no reference check); its y range
(Figure 3) is rounded outwards to a multiple of 2 and extended to hold 0.
8. Summaries per site and over all used episodes: n, mean, SD, median, range of the changes
(g C m-2 d-1 and %), the recovery share, the days to recover, the GPP drop offset (clear
drops of the timing result) and the pre-drop; counts of drops before, on and after the
recorded date. Bootstrap 95 % CI of the mean (10 000 resamples, percentile method, numpy
PCG64, fixed seeds) when n >= 3. The CIs of Deep Dive #4 come from an other generator
(mulberry32); the other numbers are equal.
9. Each step that removes rows or changes values logs a count (results.json dataVersion.steps).
10. Open findings of docs/anomaly-data-report.md that touch this dive are printed
(OPEN_FINDINGS).
openFindings: ANT-01, SAR-01, VII-01 (open, waits for the providers): the raw stamps of Anttila, Sarkisuo and Viikki are UTC, but the build reads them as UTC+2. A local day of these sites thus starts at 02:00 true local time. A daily window mean changes little; a daily change point can move by not more than 1 day.
VII-05 (open): Viikki 2024 nee_f is not equal to nee in 1 540 periods. The gap filling around the 2024 harvests can thus differ from the measured values.

literature.text: A cut removes the whole stand and with it the whole photosynthesising leaf area; regrowth uses the stored sugars and nitrogen at the base of the shoots.
literature.textFi: Koko kasvusto korjataan ja samalla menetetään koko yhteyttävä lehtipintaala.

literature.text: Timothy regrows slowly, because its regrowth starts from the buds at the base of the shoots; fescues regrow fast.
literature.textFi: Timotei on jälkikasvultaan hidas, sillä sen jälkikasvu lähtee liikkeelle versojen tyvellä olevista silmuista.

literature.text: Two or three forage yields are harvested from silage leys per season; the first is usually the largest; the regrowth stand is short and leafy and develops more slowly.
literature.textFi: Säilörehunurmista korjataan kasvukauden aikana kaksi tai kolme rehusatoa.

literature.text: Anttila 2022 management: fertilisation 23.05.2022 (52 kg N/ha), cut 21.06.2022, fertilisation 22.06.2022 (44 kg N/ha), cut 08.09.2022.
Qvidja: in August 2021, 8 cows grazed small paddocks in the EC footprint for 6 days; in August 2022, 9 cows grazed.

figures.title: Daily GPP, TER and NEE from 14 days before to 28 days after the last day of a silage harvest at Anttila (n = 4), Särkisuo (n = 3), Qvidja (n = 10) and Viikki (n = 3), as a fraction of the mean GPP of the 14 days before the harvest; mean and ± 1 SD over the episodes.
figures.desc: Four panels side by side, one per site, with the same axes. X axis: days from the last day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: GPP, TER and NEE as a fraction of the mean GPP of the days −14 to −1 before the first day of the harvest, from −1.25 to 2.25 (NEE as a fraction of the GPP before: NEE < 0 = uptake, NEE = TER − GPP). Lines, all solid: GPP light blue with circles, TER light pink with squares, NEE steel blue with triangles; markers every 7 days. The band around each line is the mean ± 1 SD over the episodes; line and band are drawn only where 2 or more episodes have a value. An orange vertical line marks day 0 (the last day of the harvest), thin lines mark 1 and 0. Anttila (n = 4; 3 to 4 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −44 % (SD 31, n 4), ΔTER 0 % (SD 8, n 4), ΔNEE 44 % (SD 30, n 4). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.56, TER 0.54, NEE −0.02; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.74, TER 0.53, NEE −0.21. Särkisuo (n = 3; 3 to 3 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −58 % (SD 19, n 3), ΔTER −3 % (SD 14, n 3), ΔNEE 56 % (SD 5, n 3). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.42, TER 0.62, NEE 0.20; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.78, TER 0.47, NEE −0.31. Qvidja (n = 10; 10 to 10 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −48 % (SD 18, n 10), ΔTER 3 % (SD 31, n 10), ΔNEE 51 % (SD 33, n 10). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.52, TER 0.62, NEE 0.10; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.66, TER 0.65, NEE 0.00. Viikki (n = 3; 3 to 3 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −44 % (SD 45, n 3), ΔTER −21 % (SD 30, n 3), ΔNEE 23 % (SD 19, n 3). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.56, TER 0.48, NEE −0.08; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.86, TER 0.69, NEE −0.18.
